system.description:
RYUKARI

Your celestial ancestry has expressed itself through pronounced fangs or claws capable of serving as natural weapons.

Choose one of the following natural attacks:

Bite 1d6 piercing; Finesse, Unarmed.

Claw 1d4 slashing; Agile, Finesse, Unarmed.

You may select this feat twice. If selected a second time, you must choose the other natural attack.

Automated: press Use to choose the Bite (1d6 piercing; Finesse, Unarmed) or the Claw (1d4 slashing; Agile, Finesse, Unarmed); it arrives as a natural attack. Taken a second time, its Use gives the other.
